name: Noto Sans Arabic
summary: Arabic sans-serif from the Noto collection, variable in width (62.5-100) and weight (100-900).
description: Noto Sans Arabic is the Noto collection's unmodulated sans-serif for Arabic-script texts. One variable font spans wght 100-900 and wdth 62.5-100, and the family also covers basic Latin, Latin Extended, math and symbols. Part of Noto, Google's collection for modern and ancient languages; free under the SIL Open Font License.
